run_trajectory_viewer: run the Streamlit trajectory viewer app to browse multi-agent rollout results from a JSONL file
build_line_index: build a byte offset index for non-empty lines in a JSONL file for fast random access
load_page: load a paginated subset of JSONL entries starting at a given index using byte offsets
decode_audio: decode a base64-encoded audio data entry from a trajectory response into raw bytes
get_topic: extract the topic or question string from a game trajectory dictionary
